digest: SHA-256 of exact original bytes; no newline or encoding normalization
producer_source: Externally reviewed full 40-character commit SHA; not local HEAD discovery
receiver_obligations: Reject unknown formats, duplicate keys, missing or extra artifact names and non-integer byte counts
Independently measure all bounded opaque bytes and compare with both manifest and handoff
Authenticate the generation and custody witness separately; supplied hashes are not provenance
Treat database.dump, roles.sql and toc.list as inert data until isolated restore admission
Inventory source and empty target event triggers before any DDL; compare access facts afterward
Keep cross-batch conflict policy and same-generation archive binding in the main restore repository
Never import sibling code, execute a TOC, source roles.sql, or infer deletion permission
